Lemma
[second variation of L-length] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 3.2.2\group Cao–Zhu Comparison Theorems for Perelman’s Reduced Volume For any $\mathcal{L}$-geodesic $\gamma $, we have egin{align*} \delta _Y^2(\mathcal{L}) & =2\sqrt{ au }\langle abla _Y Y,X angle |_0^{ ar{ au }} +\int _0^{ ar{ au }}\sqrt{ au }[2| abla _XY|^2 +2\langle R(Y,X)Y,X angle \ & \quad + abla _Y abla _YR+2 abla _X{\Ric }(Y,Y)-4 abla _Y \Ric (Y,X)]d au . \end{align*}

Proof

\sketch Differentiate the first-variation formula, commute covariant derivatives, and integrate the boundary derivative by parts.
